subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

A __frugal__ lifestyle doesn’t necessarily reflect someone’s personality.
solution:
The correct answer is: **wasteful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"frugal"** means being economical with resources, avoiding waste, and being thrifty. (मितव्ययी)
 
 
• **Example: **She leads a frugal lifestyle, always looking for ways to save money.
 
 
 
• **"Wasteful"** refers to the act of using resources carelessly, extravagantly, or to no purpose. (अपव्ययी)
 
 
• **Example: **His wasteful spending habits left him with no savings at the end of the month.
